notes.title: Level Reset 1.0 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your support and feedback! We are about to roll out our first major version update. This update will bring a more linear level experience, clearer strategic skill combinations, more balanced distribution of in-level and store resources, and significantly improved game efficiency. Both new and old players will enjoy a smoother gaming experience. Additionally, we have fixed numerous bugs reported by players.[/p][p align="justify"]95% of the levels have been reset:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]● More linear level routes[/p][p align="justify"]● Easier difficulty to get started[/p][p align="justify"]● More rhythmic progression[/p][p align="justify"]● More balanced distribution of level resources[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Bug Fixes:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the issue where some devices get stuck on the loading screen, preventing normal gameplay.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed air wall and obstruction bugs.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed monster spawn point duplication bugs.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed level continuity issues.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the problem of overlapping teleport point positions with air walls.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed skill cooldown effects.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed skill silence effects.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the healing skill bug of Nomadic Shamans.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the bug with Stone Hammer's dying strike skill[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the normal attack damage bug of Cave Spiritists.[/p][p align="justify"]● Adjusted the dying explosion skill of Wilderness Stone Hammer.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the summoning skill bug of Wilderness Archers.[/p][p align="justify"]● Fixed the issue where flying characters could be shot down by the protagonist.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Important Note:[/p][p align="justify"]Due to the extensive nature of the reset content, old save data will not be compatible. We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience and ask for your understanding. We look forward to you having a better experience with the new content! We will continue to pay attention to your feedback and welcome suggestions in the community. Thank you for your patience![/p][p align="justify"]— The Soul Revelation Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Announcement of "Soul • Apocalypto" Level Reset Plan
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you for your continuous support and feedback! We have carefully compiled all your suggestions and plan to conduct a comprehensive optimization of the game levels, including:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Route design: Adjust the exploration logic to improve fluency.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource distribution: Optimize the collection rhythm and balance strategic choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge difficulty: Restructure enemy configurations and level pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixing skill bugs: Fix the bug in the Nomadic Shaman's healing skill and the bug in the Stone Hammer's dying strike skill.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]This adjustment covers a wide range and will require some development time. We will update the progress through subsequent announcements. Your patience is crucial to us, and you are welcome to put forward suggestions in the community at any time![/p][p]
[/p][p]— The Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Development Plan: What's Next?
notes.content:
[p]The official release is just the beginning! Although we're a team of only two people, based on player feedback from all directions, all our upcoming updates will be available for free, including:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Priority fixes for major bugs, including issues with game launch, in-game bugs, and optimizations for lower-spec PCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Challenge Mode. We'll refine it to make it more meaningful, aiming to enhance the excitement and sense of achievement when players complete a challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to character skills. We'll remove some redundant skills and strengthen specific skills that align with each character's role.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaks to equipment stats, including adjustments to the drop rate of the Resurrection Necklace.[/p][/*][*][p]A significant update to the levels, which will focus the level gameplay to better complement the Challenge Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty Adjustment[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]The above content will be rolled out gradually over the next 6 months.[/p]

notes.title: Trial version 1.02 update announcement
notes.content:
Content of this update:
1.Added the function of manually challenging the enemy squad.
2.Added WADS keys for movement, while retaining the right-click on the ground for movement.
3.Added random treasure chests in the grass and grass monsters.
4.If the equipment of our side is looted, it can be retrieved by killing the looters.
5.The vein crystals that have activated skills will be recycled after the units of our side die.
6.Simplified the guidance system.
7.Fixed the UI adaptation bugs for multiple languages.

Thank you to the players for their active feedback on the game content.

notes.title: Update Notice: Core Mechanics Overhaul
notes.content:
During the trial period, we collected extensive feedback from Soul • Apocalypto players. The predominant criticism focused on the overly frequent manual collection of soul balls, which led to gameplay fatigue.
Based on your input, we’ve prioritized the following key changes:
[list]
[*] 1. Soul Furnace now auto-collects soul balls – no manual pickup required.
[*] 2. Added Auto/Manual Merge toggle to the Soul Furnace.
[*] 3. Drag Soul Cards from slots to character avatars or 3D models to upgrade allies and enhance stats.
[*] 4. Soul Card capacity doubled from 8 to 16.
[*] 5. Streamlined UI layout with enlarged critical elements for clarity.
[/list]
We’ll continue monitoring feedback and iterating on improvements. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Trial version 1.01 update announcement
notes.content:
Contents of this update:
1. The basic operations have been reworked, and the operation of the soul ball has been changed to dragging.
2. The game has added support for Japanese and Korean (not fully tested).
3. The skill values ​​of the trial boss have been corrected.
4. Elite monsters have been added.
Thank you players for your positive feedback on the game content.

notes.title: Trial version update announcement
notes.content:
[b]The main optimization contents are:[/b]
1. Add an automatic fusion switch for soul fusion
2. The team bar is classified according to the character type
3. Add gameplay and operation tips to the menu page
4. Modify the boss difficulty and add two groups of elite monsters
5. Modify some interface display errors and skill description errors

[b]We will continue to pay attention to everyone's feedback and follow up on optimization and modification. Thank you for your support[/b]

notes.title: Soul Furnace! Set Off Now!
notes.content:
We are a small development team of two people [Bu Yigang]. After one and a half years, our first work has officially exited the trial demo!
This is a patchwork monster, a monster collection and development role-playing game, but players need to fully consider their own lineup combination, and flexibly change their lineup characteristics through skill activation and replacement, so as to only see the final Boss, but the Boss is the ultimate challenge to test the strength of your team.
Currently the game supports Chinese and English. English is in the testing phase, and we will support other languages later.
If you encounter a bug during the game, or have any comments or suggestions, you can give us feedback in the comment area. We will pay attention to any suggestions and comments from you, and we value your feedback very much!
